public_rationale: The claim says that across chats Katie Conrad ran in early January 2024, Bing gave inconsistent answers about copyright, trademark, originality and how its images could be used. The evidence packet contains no evidence items. The search found the authors' own post and a later post by Conrad that describes varied Bing replies. Both come from the speaker's side, so under the contract neither counts as independent evidence. Two other sources were set aside: one covers a different incident from October 2023, and the other gives only general background on copyrighted outputs. The packet records no independent source for the chat replies the authors compared. With no independent record either way, the claim can be neither supported nor contradicted.
limitations: The packet has no independent transcript or report of the Bing replies that were compared.
The packet does not give the dates of the individual chat exchanges.
The packet notes that chat answers vary between sessions and that the January 2024 replies cannot be reproduced now.
